project.name: Management Utility for High Load Test Suite

echo.message: ${line.separator}Management utility for the OpenEdge Load Suite.
${line.separator} install - Create a PASOE instance '${instance}' with an available OEAR
wrkDir=${wrkDir} - Parent directory for PASOE instance
instance=${instance} - Name of the PASOE instance
alias=${alias} - PASOE alias used during install
${line.separator} startup - Start the PASOE instance '${instance}' (and embedded database, if available)
timeout=${timeout} - Seconds tcman waits before timing out
This is the primary way to start both PASOE and its managed database
${line.separator} enablememprof - Enable ABL memory profiling for the ${primary.ablapp.name} application
${line.separator} disablememprof - Disable ABL memory profiling for the ${primary.ablapp.name} application
${line.separator} query - Show the standard PASOE query output and database holder state
${line.separator} status - Show agent/session status for an ABL Application [${primary.ablapp.name}|${monitor.ablapp.name}]
statusapp=${statusapp} - Name of the ABL Application for status
${line.separator} shutdown - Stop the PASOE instance '${instance}' (and embedded database, if available)
${line.separator} restart - Restart the PASOE instance '${instance}' (and embedded database, if available)
timeout=${timeout} - Seconds tcman waits before timing out
${line.separator} delete - Stop and delete the PASOE instance '${instance}' (and embedded database, if available)
${line.separator} backup - Create an offline PROBKUP of the database (DB must not be running)
backupFile=${backupFile} - Destination path for the backup file
compress=${compress} - Enable PROBKUP compression via -com flag (default: false)
${line.separator} restore - Restore the database from a PROREST backup file (DB must not be running)
backupFile=${backupFile} - Path to the backup file to restore from
${line.separator} archive - Create a dated diagnostic zip archive of files from the PASOE instance
